headlines.title: 황기연 수은 행장 “ 다음 50년도 수출강국 버팀목될 것 ”
headlines.summary: 한국수출입은행 설립 50주년 기념식 AI·반도체 등 전략산업 금융지원 확대 “수출 1조달러 시대 정책금융 중심축” [한국수출입은행 제공] 황기연(사진) 수출입은행장이 은행 설립 50주년을 맞아 “다음 50년에도 대한민국 경제의 든든한 버팀목이 되겠다”고 강조했다.

headlines.title: 한국 月수출 1000억달러 첫 돌파 …獨·中·美 이은 4번째 기록
headlines.summary: 반도체 호황 힙입어 6월 1022억달러 수출 22일 관세청에 따르면 이달 1일부터 20일까지 수출은 620억 달러로 지난해 동기 대비 60.4% 증가해 동기간 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. 같은 기간 수입도 445억달러로 23.2% 늘었으며 무역수지는 175억 달러 흑자를 기록했다. 이날 인천 연수구 인천신항 컨테이너 터미널에 컨테이너가 쌓여 있다.

headlines.title: ‘월1000억弗’ 수출에도 기쁘지 않은 이유…‘ 1500원대 고환율 ’, 디커...
headlines.summary: ■ 수출액 1023억달러 ‘세계 4강’ 6월 전년 동기대비 70.9% 올라 호황지속땐 ‘年 1조달러’ 새역사 반도체도 월 400억달러 첫 돌파 무역 흑자는 300억달러 넘어서 한국의 6월 수출액이 1023억 달러를 기록하면서 ‘월 수출액 1000억 달러 시대’를 열었다.

headlines.title: “ 전고점 1560원 돌파가 분수령 …환율, 중장기로는 완만한 하락”
headlines.summary: 상반기 환율 결산·전문가 하반기 전망 6월 누적 평균 1484.6원…외환위기 맞먹어 전문가 “연말께 떨어질것”…시점은 ‘온도차’ 상반기 평균 원/달러 환율이 외환위기 수준에 맞먹는 1484.6원으로 집계됐다. 이란전쟁에 이어 외국인 국내 주식 순매도, 미국 금리 인상 우려 등 연이은 악재가 원화 가치 하락을 부추긴 결과다.

headlines.title: [Why&Next]"6월 평균 1528원"…연말 환율 ' 1430원 vs 1530원 ', 핵심 변수는
headlines.summary: 월·분기·반기 평균 환율, 외환위기 이후 최고 1일 역시 상승하며 1560원 선 위협 하반기, 강달러·엔화 약세 추이 주목 외국인 리밸런싱·자본유출 기조·심리 등 관건 지난달 원·달러 환율 평균이 1530원에 근접하면서 1998년 외환위기 이후 최고치를 기록했다. 2분기(4~6월) 평균 역시 1500원을 넘어섰다.

headlines.title: "韓경제 올해 4% 성장" 전망 나와… 반도체 호황에 일제히 상향 조정
headlines.summary: 국내외 기관 10여 곳 3%대 전망 반도체 경기가 예상보다 더 강한 호조세를 띠면서 올해 우리나라 경제성장률이 4%에 달할 것이라는 전망이 나왔다. 1일 금융권에 따르면 영국 캐피털 이코노믹스(CE)는 최근 보고서에서 우리나라의 올해 실질 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률 전망치를 4.0%로 제시했다. 이 기관은 지난 2월 1.0%에서 3월 1.6%, 4월 2.

headlines.title: SK, 메가프로젝트 전력 셀프공급 … 10GW 신재생에너지기업 세운다
headlines.summary: 연말 통합법인 ‘홀드코’ 출범 2031년까지 원전 10기 규모 SK가 세계 최대 사모펀드 그룹인 콜버그크래비스로버츠(KKR)와 손잡고 올해 말 국내 최대 규모 신재생에너지 기업을 출범한다.

headlines.title: 반도체만 잔치 , 석화·철강‘신음’… K굴뚝 식어간다
headlines.summary: ■ “이러다간 10년 내 반도체 빼고 중국에 다 넘어가” 여수·포항 상가공실 등 지역경제 휘청 “반도체처럼 챙겨달라” 울상 정부 관계자 ‘차이나 리스크’ 경고 “한국, 중국 보다 나은 건 반도체 뿐” 김성훈·신병남 기자, 포항=박천학·여수=김대우 기자 “지역 전통산업의 근간이 휘청거리는데 경기는 오죽하겠습니까.

headlines.title: 재경부, 공급망 선도사업자 29개 기업 신규 선정 … 총 216개사

headlines.title: 중동 리스크 대응 … 정부, 공급망 선도기업 29곳 추가 지정
headlines.summary: 핵심광물·이차전지·물류 분야 선정…누적 216개사로 확대 공급망안정화기금 우대 지원…대출 한도 확대·금리 혜택 "공급망 핵심기업 지속 발굴…대외 충격 대응 역량 강화" [카비마스=AP/뉴시스] 2026년 1월 7일(현지시간) 베네수엘라 카비마스에 사용되지 않는 원유 펌프잭이 서 있는 모습. 2026.06.02.

headlines.title: “ 이미 예상했던 일 … 규제 상관없이 집 살 것 ”

headlines.title: “ 깎아달라 ” “ 못 내린다 ”… 용인 기흥은 ‘ 줄다리기중 ’
headlines.summary: 막판 계약 전화 급증, 한편에선 급매 문의 집주인들 “놔두면 결국에는 오른다” 느긋 매수자·매도자 상황별 복잡한 셈법에 혼선 긴가민가했는데 이렇게 갑자기 규제지역으로 묶을 줄은 몰랐죠. 당장 계약하려는 20대 신혼부부 거래를 중개 중인데 몇천만원이라도 깎고싶어 하지만 집주인은 급할 거 없단 입장이에요.

headlines.title: ‘ 기간 프리미엄 ’ 3년7개월만 최고 … 장기금리 · 주담대 압박

headlines.title: 반숙란 2알에 2700원 …가구에 섬유유연제까지 오른다

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing a bifurcated growth pattern, with the semiconductor sector driving strong export performance and GDP growth projections, while traditional industries like petrochemicals and steel face significant challenges. June exports reached a record $102.3 billion, marking entry into the $100 billion monthly export era, with semiconductor exports alone breaking through $40 billion for the first time. However, this heavy reliance on semiconductors raises concerns about economic vulnerability, with experts warning that without broader industrial development, China could dominate all other sectors within a decade. The semiconductor boom has prompted numerous economic institutions to raise 2026 GDP growth forecasts to 4%, up from previous 3% projections, suggesting the strong momentum could be sustained throughout the year.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's real GDP growth is now projected to reach 4% in 2026, marking a significant upward revision from earlier 3% forecasts as the semiconductor sector outperforms expectations and shows broader spillover effects. The term premium on 10-year government bonds has climbed to 1.4%, the highest level in 3 years and 7 months, reflecting concerns about inflation and continued fiscal expansion pressuring long-term interest rates. Government bond yields have exceeded 4% and residential mortgage rates have surged to an average of 4.32%, creating affordability challenges for homebuyers and constraining consumption. Japan's government has announced plans to shift toward expansionary fiscal policy starting 2027, targeting 3% nominal GDP growth and 1% real growth, which could influence regional economic dynamics. Currency pressures persist as the won-dollar exchange rate hits 17-year highs amid global interest rate increases.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined 2.04% to 8,303.41 on the first day of the second half amid semiconductor stock weakness and foreign investor net selling, while the KOSDAQ rose 1% to mark its 30th anniversary of listing. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix dropped 5% and 3% respectively despite strong overnight U.S. semiconductor index performance, suggesting domestic investors remained cautious due to rising U.S. Treasury yields and won weakness. Foreign investors continued to net sell domestic stocks while individuals provided sole support, highlighting divergent sentiment in the market. The won-dollar exchange rate reached its highest level in 17 years at around 1,500 won per dollar, driven by expectations of U.S. rate increases and yen weakness creating downward pressure on the won. Bond repo outstanding has increased by 100 trillion won over the past year as investors bet on further rate increases.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector shows exceptional strength with export volumes and profitability surging, while petrochemicals and battery industries face credit rating downgrades amid oversupply and margin compression. Samsung SDI expects a turnaround in 2026 based on recent energy storage system project wins and premium electric vehicle supply contracts, though traditional manufacturing sectors including petrochemicals and battery makers face deteriorating credit ratings. Defense, shipbuilding, and semiconductor industries show improved credit metrics, while power equipment manufacturers also benefit from better business conditions. High-value sectors including advanced semiconductor packaging materials and high-definition display materials are emerging as growth drivers. The credit market is pricing in divergent outlooks with semiconductor and technology firms improving ratings while traditional heavy industries face downgrades.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices have maintained a remarkable 72-week consecutive uptrend with prices rising 0.30% this week, demonstrating sustained strength in Korea's residential real estate market. The shift from leasing to sales transactions has become pronounced, with apartment sales transactions surpassing lease contracts for the first time in 6 years as rising deposit requirements push tenants toward purchase options. Seoul city government has announced regulatory adjustments in redevelopment promotion zones, relaxing floor area ratio and non-residential restrictions in 5 areas including Yangcheon-gu Shinjeong-dong to encourage development. The government is examining measures to make housing subscription savings tax deductions permanent to address declining participation, noting account numbers have fallen from 26.77 million in 2021 to 24.80 million by May 2026. Multiple price indices across sales, leases, and monthly rentals show triple-strength gains, indicating broad-based residential market momentum.
sections.International Economy: South Korea faces growing non-tariff barriers in agricultural and food exports despite the K-food trend, with inconsistent regulations, hygiene requirements, and certification standards across different markets creating compliance burdens for exporting companies. K-food exports have expanded beyond traditional US-China-Japan markets to Southeast Asia, Central/South America, and Europe, but customs procedures, technical regulations, quarantine standards, and certification requirements vary significantly by country. The U.S. federal court struck down limitations on birthright citizenship, removing one of Trump's symbolic policies alongside reciprocal tariffs, potentially affecting immigration and economic policy frameworks. The potential non-renewal of USMCA after its 10-year term could end the current North American free trade framework, with preliminary analyses suggesting the agreement may expire in 2036 without renewal. U.S. AI export restrictions on Anthropic were lifted after just 18 days, allowing resumed access by Korean companies and institutions in the Project Glasswing security alliance.
sections.AI & Economy: The U.S. government lifted export restrictions on Anthropic's advanced AI models 'Mithos5' and 'Fable5' after 18 days, allowing Korean companies and institutions to resume access through the Project Glasswing security alliance, though the gap in competitive dynamics has widened as Chinese firms released competing models during the restriction period. Anthropic responded to the regulatory relief by immediately launching 'Sonnet5,' a high-performance low-cost model, intensifying the cost competition in the global AI market where companies increasingly face significant charges for deploying AI solutions. Physical AI robotics saw over 10 trillion won in investment inflows to Chinese humanoid robot companies in just the first half of 2026, demonstrating the rapid growth of AI-enabled robotics attracting venture capital attention. Korean financial groups are increasing exposure to physical AI and robot ecosystems, with KB Financial Group and others investing and sponsoring initiatives in anticipation of the emerging market, while competing to integrate AI into their service offerings. The government emphasizes both aggressive AI investment and regulatory rationalization as critical for competitiveness, with addressing youth employment as the highest priority alongside fostering AI industry growth.
sections.Others: Bitcoin surpassed 90 million won amid capital flowing toward AI investments and technology stocks, though broader sentiment remains cautious due to Fed rate hold expectations and shifting capital allocation away from cryptocurrencies. AI development companies are increasingly competing on value-for-money models as enterprises face rising costs from deploying generative AI, with Anthropic's cost-effective 'Sonnet5' launch intended partly to counter Chinese AI competition. The Bank of Korea governor proposed a central bank digital currency (CBDC) framework based on trusted institutions, suggesting it could coexist with private stablecoins while maintaining greater safety and central bank credibility compared to decentralized alternatives. Intense competition is emerging in the Korean conglomerate landscape between Samsung and SK groups, with Samsung emphasizing battery and bioscience investments while SK focuses on 2.1 quadrillion won in AI infrastructure and development. The USMCA trade agreement faces uncertainty with the Trump administration signaling potential non-renewal, potentially ending North American free trade arrangements after 2036 unless renegotiated.
